subject: Food Science
title: Sulfites in Wine
description: A quick win: understand Sulfites in Wine.

hook.text: 'Contains sulfites' appears on every wine bottle. Ancient Romans burned sulfur candles in wine barrels too.

buildup.text: Sulfites prevent oxidation and kill unwanted bacteria, keeping wine stable during aging and transport.

discovery.text: Yeast naturally produces some sulfites during fermentation. Even 'no added sulfite' wines contain small amounts.

twist.text: About 1% of people are sulfite-sensitive, experiencing asthma-like symptoms. Labeling became mandatory in 1986.

climax.text: Dried fruits contain 5–10 times more sulfites than wine. Yet only wine carries the warning label.

punchline.text: Wine gets the warning. Dried apricots get a free pass. Same chemical.

quiz.question: Which food typically contains more sulfites than wine?
options: Dried fruits like apricots contain 5–10 times more
